original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: An operational timber skiffyard with a boat lowered into its channel, open launch ramp, taut sails, and raised route pennants.
An operational stone pilot post with an unfurled route chart, raised signal flag, extended gangway, and lit watch lantern.
An operational channel bell pulled outward on a taut rope beneath raised vanes, an open lantern, and a tensioned guide chain.
A wreck-built quay with a broad straight boarding lane, pulled-aside spars, taut guide ropes, lit posts, and a raised route pennant.
An operational paired mooring with aligned capstans, a taut guided chain span, upright route hooks, and an open plank crossing.
An operational reed skiff shelf with its boat on a deployed launch ramp, working poles upright, lashings open, and a route pennant raised.
A blackwood route post with twin fogglass vanes, chart tube, guide cords, and a small pilot lantern.
A weathered measuring arch with brass plumb, unequal survey arms, boundary chain, and sliding gauge.
A living root gate with three unequal seed lanterns, knotted relief cords, and road-pointing exposed roots.
A low basalt enclosure surrounds three banked ember vents beneath an immense shovel-horn stone arch.
The Cinderwake Fold stands open beside stocked mineral troughs, copper guide lamps, and two ring-notched claim pennants.
Pale saltstone uprights hold curved sea-glass membranes and bell resonators over a shallow tidal pool.
The Tideglass Roost is supplied with rolled harnesses, ration cases, blue guide lamps, and two ring-notched claim pennants.
A sweeping pale basalt horn arch shelters an empty circular fold beneath three copper wind vanes.
The Galehorn Windfold is swept and supplied with folded harnesses, feed sacks, guide lamps, and notched claim pennants.
Three offset brass hoops carry amber mineral lanterns and scale-like roof fins above an empty feeding basin.
The Sunscale Conservatory holds mineral feed, covered stores, coiled harnesses, cool guide lamps, and a notched claim pennant.
Four swept froststone prongs surround an empty icy roost beneath one suspended silver bell.
The Rimebell Eyrie has a raised bell, cleared ramp, bundled sky harnesses, warm guide light, and two notched claim pennants.
Seven overlapping blackstone and brass plates seal a squat vault behind a circular pressure trough.
The Seventh Vault stands open and stable beside armored harness rolls, sealed stores, cool guide lamps, and two notched claim pennants.
A six-legged darkwood field desk holds a blank ledger beneath a tall quill mast and brass plumb.
Six small wax witness marks line the Pactwright Waydesk after the local road evidence is recorded.
Two smoky siltglass tablets stand in wet reed bindings around a narrow bronze tally pointer.
A small two-tone diamond counterseal now hangs from the Siltglass Index without obscuring either tablet.
A horizontal pale crystal lens rests above a low brass meridian table partly embraced by living roots.
A two-tone diamond counterseal marks the Greenline Lens Table while the original roots and crystal measure remain visible.
A circular woven-reed frame holds an amber votive flame and three pale jaw-shaped mineral charms.
A two-tone diamond counterseal joins the Reedflame Votive Frame while its amber flame and old ferry charms remain intact.
Three pale mineral arches suspend a dusk-blue prism over a compact black mirrored basin.
A two-tone diamond counterseal hangs beside the tuned Ossuary Prism Choir without covering its suspended prism.
A luminous mushroom bell hangs over a peat-dark resonance bowl between three curled reedwood legs.
A two-tone diamond counterseal marks the sounded Glowcap Echo Bell while its cap and dark bowl remain fully readable.
A forked brass mast balances a clear diamond kite vane, a pale counter-vane, and two hanging weights.
A two-tone diamond counterseal completes the balanced Kite-Signal Countermast while both opposed vanes remain visible.
An ivory road spire bears a large bronze bell, three hanging lamps, red oath cords, and deep waymark grooves.
A broad hide drum rests on a wet black bogstone cairn between hooked reed pipes and a sealed silt jar.
Three asymmetric crystal lenses orbit a suspended mirror shard above an engraved white-gold observatory plinth.
A gnarled living stump embraces a carved greenstone tablet beneath one arch of broad copper-red blossoms.
A massive asymmetric brass clamp locks around a basalt anvil beside a compact banked coal furnace and gauge.
A narrow salt-dark memorial stone stands inside a crooked whale-bone arch with one black glass bell and flowing mist.
A low octagonal blackstone table carries seven unequal ivory tally pegs, a suspended brass plumb, and a slate disk.

original_manifest_entry.presentation_role: sealed powder wharf and stormseal winch
original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: A rain-dark timber wharf holds a sealed bronze bombard tube, cold brazier, red wax storm seal, and chain winch.
The wharf's tube stands open beside a warm brazier, raised ember pennant, powder casks, and a ready winch.

original_manifest_entry.presentation_role: moon jar and bone-arched reed circle
original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: Crooked wetland stones and pale reeds surround a sealed peatglass moon jar beneath a bone-chain arch and cold lanterns.
Moonwax lanterns glow around the opened jar, supplied peatwax vessels, racked reedcaster staffs, and a ragged crescent pennant.

original_manifest_entry.presentation_role: folded seven-face prism and noon dial
original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: An ivory watch dais supports a folded brass prism, shuttered mirror fins, and an unlit circular noon dial.
The seven-faced prism opens into a star silhouette above bright mirror fins, sentinel shields, and a raised saffron pennant.

original_manifest_entry.presentation_role: dormant heartseed and folded branch ballistae
original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: A living-wood arch curls around a dormant amber heartseed with folded branch-ballista arms, empty racks, and closed leaf lamps.
The heartseed glows between tensioned branch ballistae, dawnseed bolt bundles, open leaf lamps, and a grown green-gold pennant.

original_manifest_entry.presentation_role: silent assay bell and cold gauge
original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: A broad brass bell hangs over black brick beside a zeroed pressure gauge, locked gaugeplate locker, and cold quench trough.
The bell striker rises above a safe green gauge, steaming quench trough, stacked gaugeplate shields, and heavy crossbows.

original_manifest_entry.presentation_role: furled pearl sail and saltglass bell
original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: A pale driftwood bell-frame stands on a tiny salt-stone pier with a dark lantern, coiled tidehooks, and a furled pearl sail.
A raised pearl sail towers over the softly lit bell, bright lantern, racked tidehooks, and three memory-salt urns.

registration_policy: Exact original crop, fit and anchor; source RGBA reconstructed at 4x. Historical 48px comparison is measured evidence, not a claim to have recovered undocumented old resampling. Coast differences remain recorded. Pactwright retains six original raster witness marks and restores original master colors without its coarse old whole-image grade.
